I've saved the draft mail to Marcus Lindqvist (mlindqvist@pemberline.com). It hasn't been sent, so someone still needs to review it and send it.

- **Subject:** "Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Content:** It gives the rate as $1,752 a seat, the figure from your message, and says you approved sharing it with him. It also asks Marcus to check with you or June before he passes the rate on to anyone else.

Your message was all the approval this needed, since you're the CFO. Marcus has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth didn't need to approve it. I used the figure exactly as you wrote it. I didn't check it against Pree's own messages, because those are private to her.
